notes: Phasor_m7 fine-tunes the frozen, open-weight Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365 checkpoint (backbone entirely unmodified, verified via exact DiT weight-sum match before/after every training run) with rank-4 LoRA adapters on the VLM's language_model attention/MLP layers, plus our own sparse end-to-end memory core (Hopfield network + HGRN gate + adaptive gate) applied to pooled VLM hidden states as an additive consolidation-loss regularizer during training. Trained on real RoboCasa365 data (NVIDIA PhysicalAI-Robotics-Manipulation-Kitchen-Demos), restricted to the 34 official atomic_seen+composite_seen tasks (composite_unseen correctly held out of training as the generalization test split). Results are from a completed, official 50-task/2500-episode target50 eval run (2500/2500 episodes, 0 errors). For reference, the frozen base checkpoint (no fine-tuning) scores atomic_seen=79.44, composite_seen=57.63, composite_unseen=30.75 on this same protocol -- Phasor_m7 is essentially tied on atomic_seen and slightly behind baseline on composite_seen/composite_unseen in this run; a matched LoRA-only ablation (same data, same fix, no memory core) is in progress to isolate whether the memory-core term specifically helps or hurts relative to LoRA alone. date/code_url/checkpoint_url/open_source are placeholders pending a decision on public release; commit_hash reflects the exact training/eval code state used to produce this result. training_config.num_training_steps (220) reflects LoRA+memory-core fine-tuning steps only, starting from Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365's own already-pretrained weights (not a from-scratch training budget).
